item.title: Wakulla High School winter guard excels in competition circuit
item.description: Wakulla High School's winter guard is making their mark, and after being promoted to a tougher division, they're still bringing home hardware.

item.title: Tallahassee screening explores African American, Jewish unity during civil rights movement
item.description: Community members learned about African American and Jewish collaboration during the civil rights movement at a "Shared Legacies" screening Wednesday.

item.title: Valdosta's major road projects show progress despite commuter frustrations
item.description: Valdosta's Five Points roundabout is about 49% complete and ahead of schedule, while Jerry Jones Road widening progresses slowly. Commuters meanwhile are facing daily detours.
